title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
subtitle: From 2 to 100, discover which numbers are multiples and which remain prime.
remainingDescription: Of the numbers that have not been locked, {{remaining}} remain, and {{primes}} of those are prime.

messages.chooseBase: Choose a base and start the sieve.
messages.selectedBase: We are now working with base {{prime}}. Its multiples are highlighted on the board.
messages.baseIsNotMultiple: {{number}} is the base for this step, not a multiple.
messages.alreadyClaimedBy: {{number}} has already been correctly locked by {{name}}.
messages.claimedBySelf: {{number}} has already been correctly locked by {{name}}.

grid.lockedByOther: {{number}} has already been locked by another student

teacher.stepSubtitle: The teacher chooses which sieve is active
teacher.ruleText: Select every multiple of {{prime}} that is greater than {{prime}} itself.
teacher.ruleTeacher: The teacher changes only the base.
teacher.ruleStudents: Students select the correct multiples without taking one another's choices.
teacher.ruleLocked: Correctly locked numbers are removed from play.
teacher.goalCorrect: Correct choices are assigned to a specific student and cannot be repeated by others.
teacher.goalWrong: Incorrect choices are tracked separately to show each student's strategy.
teacher.goalProgress: The class moves from 2 to 3 to 5 and onward until only the primes remain.
